declared_unchecked: *::protocol_id: checked as a constant by check_constants, not per report
CONFIRMATION_COHORT.json::*: cohort legality metadata; the program digests are recomputed from the pinned inputs by programs()
ENGINEERING_DECISION.json::parity_evidence: free text naming a test file
ENGINEERING_DECISION.json::reason: free text restating the recomputed decision
FROZEN_SELECTION.json::inference.*: free text and the route constants (compared with ROUTES by check_constants)
FROZEN_SELECTION.json::learning_track.*: source hashes of the learning track; the successor checker owns source identity
FROZEN_SELECTION.json::reporting.*: source hash; the successor checker owns it
FROZEN_SELECTION.json::sources.*: source hashes at the freeze; the successor checker owns source identity
LEARNING_FEASIBILITY.json::evaluation_sensitivity.*.decode_mismatches: needs the codec (structural_encoding.decode); the auditor imports no codec
SELECTION.json::selection.rule: free text restating the rule that is recomputed
export/candidate/EXPORT_VALIDATION.json::pinned.*: pinned-workspace evidence; exit codes are compared, identity strings are labels
export/candidate/compiler_MANIFEST.json::owner_generator_sha256: hash of the frozen owner generator; checker
learning/DESIGN_*.json::designs.*.ranker_input: absolute path; its hash is checked
learning/DESIGN_*.json::designs.*.sensitivity.decode_mismatches: needs the codec (structural_encoding.decode); the auditor imports no codec
learning/DESIGN_*.json::manifest: path; the manifest it names is read and checked
